## Analysis overview

Selects safety subjects with treatment-emergent events, counts subjects and events overall, by system organ class, and by preferred term, calculates percentages using ADSL denominators, and adds treatment-comparison p-values.

## ADaM datasets

- `ADAE`
- `ADSL`

## Key ADaM variables

- `USUBJID`: subject identifier
- `SAFFL`: safety flag
- `TRTEMFL`: treatment-emergent flag
- `AEBODSYS`: system organ class
- `AETERM`: reported/preferred event term used in the display
- `TRTA/TRTAN`: actual treatment
- `AESER`: serious-event flag
- `TRT01P/TRT01PN in ADSL`: denominator treatment.
